presentation_differences: Unsupported Framingham and ASCVD names are replaced with Legacy points estimate and Legacy coefficient estimate.
All ten named risk-factor checkboxes are retained and risk_factor_count is derived from their selections.
logic_differences: LDL, triglyceride and statin inputs are retained as optional context without contributing to the legacy formulas; diastolic pressure remains required only to characterize legacy inputs although the formula does not use it.
unresolved_clinical_ambiguities: A cardiovascular clinician must either replace both simplified formulas with a validated implementation and governing citations or retire this tool.
Approve the supported population, variables, units, risk-enhancer behavior, categories, and clinical recommendations.
reviewer_decision: Pending independent cardiovascular-clinician approval. Do not approve or publish this review draft.
